extraction: Downloaded public VN-NARIC HTML pages 0..37 and extracted table name, English name, short name, website and address. Excluded college and vocational rows; merged identical hosts and known historical/alternate domains; added KMA official domain; retained provenance per record.
limitations: Not a claim of a complete current legal institution census. Registry mixes historical names, duplicate records, branches, constituent schools and tertiary/vocational providers.

Registry contains substantive errors: hcmiu.edu.vn reused for dozens of unrelated institutions; hpmu.edu.vn reused for Thai Nguyen agriculture; these erroneous mappings removed, not trusted merely because source official.
Page0 and page1 return same rows; last pages overlap; published row numbers start21. First20 records cannot be confirmed from pagination.
TLS certificate for en.naric.edu.vn has hostname mismatch; read-only public fetch used verify=False, content provenance preserved.
Institution websites not individually inspected for all rows; HTTP retrieval status does not establish current accreditation, degree authority, completeness or name currency.
Historical/alternate domains retained as aliases where known; some renamed/merged institutions remain requiring review.
University systems and member institutions are separate records; branch and constituent types marked when apparent.
